messages.subject: [Reddyproc-users] Does ReddyProc calculate uncertainties around GPP and Reco?
messages.subject_clean: [Reddyproc-users] Does ReddyProc calculate uncertainties around GPP and Reco?
messages.body_plain:
Dear ReddyProc community,

I am wondering if ReddyProc calculates uncertainties around GPP and Reco estimations. If so, is it specified in a column from the predefined output? I was looking for something like NEE_fsd for GPP and Reco. I am using the R code downloaded at my laptop.

Best,
Efr?n

messages.subject: [Reddyproc-users] GPP and Reco uncertainties
messages.body_plain:
Hi Efren,

at the moment we do not have uncertainty estimates for GPP and Reco. In a future release we will include the Ustar filtering and the uncertainty of GPP and Reco can be computed,
Please let  me know if you need any further information
All the best
Mirco
